title: Reverse-engineered craft flown only with the mind

tellings.quote: you you hear other stories of the >> reverse engineering program involving like the only way to fly the craft is with your mind

plain: There are stories, Michels says, of a secret program copying recovered non-human craft in which the only way to fly the craft is with your mind. He brings it up in passing, as something he has heard from others he does not name, in an episode with the researcher Tim Alberino; if true, it would mean the craft respond to thought rather than controls.
